skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Operate Twitter/X through the inference.sh CLI. Post text or media, manage engagement, send messages, follow users, and retrieve account or post details.
skill.summary: Run common Twitter/X publishing and engagement actions from an AI-assisted CLI workflow.
skill.author: infsh-skills

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally invokes inference.sh commands that can publish, delete, message, follow, and engage through an external X account. Most static alerts are Markdown syntax, but unpinned skill installation, a remote image, and automation abuse potential remain material concerns.

remediation.issue: The installation examples fetch skills without pinning an immutable version or commit.
remediation.suggestion: Pin every package and remote skill to a reviewed version or commit, and document how users can verify its integrity.

remediation.issue: Several commands create irreversible or public account actions.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before posting, deleting, liking, retweeting, messaging, or following, and display the target account and content.

remediation.issue: Automated direct messages and follows can be used for spam or platform abuse.
remediation.suggestion: Add consent, rate-limit, audience-selection, and X policy checks before bulk or repeated engagement actions.

remediation.issue: The documentation embeds an image from an external host.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle a local reviewed image or disclose that rendering the documentation may contact inference.sh.

content.user_title: Automate Twitter and X Account Actions
content.value_statement: Managing routine X actions across separate tools takes time and creates inconsistent workflows. This skill provides focused CLI commands for publishing, engagement, messaging, and retrieval.
actual_capabilities: Posts text tweets through the x/post-tweet app.
Creates posts with externally hosted image or video media.
Likes, retweets, retrieves, and deletes posts by identifier.
Sends direct messages and follows users through an authenticated account.
Combines generated image or video output with an X publishing workflow.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, and a configured X integration.
Examples use placeholder identifiers and require users to supply valid account targets.
The documented workflows do not provide scheduling, moderation, retries, or analytics.
Publishing and engagement commands can create immediate external side effects.

use_cases.title: Publish Campaign Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare and publish reviewed text or media updates from a repeatable command workflow.

use_cases.title: Share Product Releases
use_cases.description: Post concise release announcements and retrieve the resulting post for verification.

use_cases.title: Manage Community Responses
use_cases.description: Retrieve profiles and send approved direct responses to known community members.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Text Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft one X post about [topic] for [audience]. Keep it under [limit] characters and wait for my approval before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Publish Approved Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an X post using this approved text: [text]. Attach media from [media URL], show the final content, and request confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Target Before Engagement
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the X profile for [username] and summarize relevant public details. Do not follow, message, like, or retweet without separate approval.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Controlled Release Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a release workflow for [announcement]. Generate media, prepare the post, validate identifiers and links, and require confirmation before every external action.

output_examples.input: Draft an X post announcing version 2.1 to existing users.
output_examples.output: Version 2.1 is available with faster search and clearer export controls. Review the release notes and share your feedback.

output_examples.input: Check the profile for OpenAI before preparing a response.
output: No follow, message, like, or retweet action was performed.
Review the retrieved profile details before approving another action.

output_examples.input: Prepare a product image post and ask before publishing.
output: Post text and media reference are prepared.
The target account and final content require review.
Publishing is waiting for explicit confirmation.

best_practices: Review the target account, post content, links, and media before every external action.
Use explicit confirmation for publishing, deletion, direct messages, follows, likes, and retweets.
Respect X policies, recipient consent, rate limits, and organizational approval requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not automate bulk follows, unsolicited messages, or repetitive engagement.
Do not publish generated media before checking ownership, accuracy, and disclosure requirements.
Do not place credentials, private data, or confidential content in command inputs.

faq.question: What setup does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, and a working X integration.

faq.question: Can it publish posts with media?
faq.answer: Yes. The x/post-create app accepts post text and a media URL for an image or video.

faq.question: Does it schedule posts?
faq.answer: No scheduling command is documented. Use an external scheduler or an approved orchestration system.

faq.question: Can it delete a post?
faq.answer: Yes. The x/post-delete app deletes a post by identifier and should require explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages or follow users?
faq.answer: Yes. Use these actions only for approved recipients and accounts, with consent and rate limits.

faq.question: Does it provide analytics or moderation?
faq.answer: No. The documented apps cover account actions and retrieval, not analytics, moderation, or campaign reporting.
